text.p: MSAS Cargo International said Geoff Corpe will become executive director - Europe, responsible for Belgium, Belgium Logistics, France, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Ireland, Norway, Portugal, Spain and the UK with effect from April 1.
He was previously executive director UK, Far East, South Africa and Air Link, it added in a statement.
Mick Fountain keeps responsibility for the U.S., Latin America and Canada, but adds Japan, Korea, Australia, New Zealand and Air Link and becomes executive director - America-Pacific.

It said Edward Hope, previously executive director Continental Europe and Africa, becomes executive director Africa, Middle East and India, responsible for South Africa and MSAS' current agency operations in the rest of the area.
The company has plans to make a significant investment in India in 1997, and Hope will establish a expansion strategy for the Middle East and Africa.
Stephen Chan's responsibilities as executive director --- South East Asia, MSAS' largest area in terms of profit --, sales and people remain unchanged, it added.
All the changes will take effect on 1 April 1997. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
